repo_notes.content: nix-os is the NixOS configuration of ONE small, live VPS (Hostinger KVM 1: 1 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 50 GB disk), hostname srv2108887, serving www.piabrota.art. It is a flake with one system, nixosConfigurations.piabrota, on nixos-26.05. It is not a library or a template for many machines, though docs/FORK.md explains how to fork it for another VPS.

A merge to main IS the deploy: .github/workflows/deploy.yml builds the system on a GitHub runner (job `build`, which saves the Nix store in GitHub's Actions cache) and deploy-rs copies it over SSH as the `deploy` user and switches the VPS (job `deploy`). If SSH does not answer within 60 seconds after the switch, or a unit fails during activation, deploy-rs rolls the VPS back ('magic rollback'). The VPS never compiles. Changes to Markdown only do not deploy. When a deploy fails, .github/workflows/deploy-doctor.yml runs piabrota/agents' deploy-doctor on a GitHub runner; nothing of piabrota/agents runs on the box.

AGENTS.md is the source of truth for rules: the file table, 'Do not break the machine' (settings that keep the VPS reachable: qemu guest agent, cloud-init, OpenSSH, GRUB on /dev/sda, the deploy user, magic rollback; never change system.stateVersion), the resource budget, and the rules for commits and PRs. Prefer its wording when documenting rules.

Resource budget: every change is judged by what it adds to the system closure (measured with dix) and to resident memory. No GUI, fonts or desktop services; no heavy runtimes for small jobs; no resident daemons the host does not need. tools.nix removes the NixOS manual and caps the journal; deploy.nix sets garbage collection and keeps five boot generations.

The repository's own modules use the option namespace piabrota.*: piabrota.site (site.nix), piabrota.loco.apps.<name> (loco.nix), piabrota.pgx (pgx.nix). configuration.nix imports them and turns them on, with hermes.nix (services.hermes-agent, the upstream module from the flake input hermes-agent) and kubesolo-purge.nix.

Secrets never live in the repository (it is public). They are files on the box written by hand: /var/lib/loco-secrets/<app>.env for Loco apps, /var/lib/hermes-secrets/hermes.env for Hermes Agent (copied into its .env at activation), and PGX's generated password. Units read them with EnvironmentFile or systemd LoadCredential. Document where a secret lives and how it is written, never a value.

KubeSolo (single-node Kubernetes) ran here from 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-02 with rax and piabrota/agents on it, and was then removed with k8s/ and its docs (git history has them). kubesolo-purge.nix is a oneshot that clears, once, what it left on the box (pods, mounts, /var/lib/kubesolo, cni0, KUBE- and CNI- rules); it runs only while /var/lib/kubesolo exists and is deleted in a later PR. docs/KUBERNETES.md and docs/MICROK8S.md are research only.

Hermes Agent (github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent, Nous Research) runs as the unit hermes-agent from its flake's NixOS module (hermes.nix): native mode, not a container; the minimal package plus the anthropic and messaging extras; Claude (claude-sonnet-5-5) through the owner's subscription, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; MemoryMax 1G; state in /var/lib/hermes. Upstream calls Nix a best-effort Tier 2 platform, so flake.lock pins a commit and only the weekly flake-update PR moves it. See docs/HERMES.md.

PGX (pgx.dev) is a Postgres-compatible engine in Rust used for data that can be lost; nothing uses it since KubeSolo left, and it stays for the next workload that needs Postgres. Apps keep their own data in SQLite: no PostgreSQL server or Redis for an app.

Documentation is bilingual: pt-BR first with an English mirror (docs/X.ptBR.md and docs/X.md; wiki/ pages Home, Arquitetura, Operacao, Maquetes with Home-EN, Architecture, Operations, Mockups). Mirrors change together. This DeepWiki should be written in English and may cite either language's file.

Figures and drawings are generated, never hand-edited: archify figures from docs/archify/*.json (just figure), the homepage mockups from mockups/*.nix (just mockups), the README drawing from drawings/mu.nix (just drawing). CI fails when a committed output is stale.
Dates in the docs are real (the repository was built in late October 2026). Measurements carry their date; numbers marked with a warning sign were not measured on the machine.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What nix-os is: one live VPS as a flake, what it serves, how a merge becomes a deploy, the machine's size, and where to start reading (README.md, AGENTS.md).

pages.title: The flake and its modules
pages.purpose: flake.nix's outputs (nixosConfigurations, deploy, checks, packages, devShells) and configuration.nix with the modules it imports, the piabrota.* options each defines, and how they fit together.

pages.title: Users, tools and the resource budget
pages.purpose: piabrota.nix (the h0ffmann user, SSH key only, flakes) and tools.nix (the CLI tools, documentation removed, journald caps, zram), and the resource budget rules in AGENTS.md: closure size, dix, no GUI, no heavy runtimes.

pages.title: Do not break the machine
pages.purpose: The settings that keep the VPS reachable and provisionable by Hostinger (qemu guest agent with its PATH, cloud-init, OpenSSH, GRUB, the deploy user, magic rollback, stateVersion), why each exists, and how to undo a bad switch.

pages.title: Deploying
pages.purpose: deploy.yml's build and deploy jobs, deploy-rs and magic rollback, the Nix store cache, deploy.nix (the deploy user, garbage collection, generations), the secrets the workflow uses, and docs/DEPLOY.md's one-time setup.

pages.title: CI and checks
pages.purpose: ci.yml (nix flake check, nixpkgs-fmt, statix, deadnix, shellcheck, figure-check), the justfile's recipes, the flake's checks (the system, deploy-rs, loco-example, the pgx VM test, mockups, drawing), cves.yml, freeze.yml and the scripts in scripts/.

pages.title: The site
pages.purpose: site.nix and site/: the Gleam and Lustre site prerendered at build time, its three designs from mockups/data.nix, nginx with ACME, the www redirect, and site/DESIGN.md's look.

pages.title: Mockups, figures and drawings
pages.purpose: mockups/ (SVG in pure Nix), the archify figures (docs/archify, vendor/archify, just figure) and drawings/ (the mu drawing from Desmos equations), and the CI checks that keep their outputs in sync.

pages.title: Loco apps
pages.purpose: loco.nix's piabrota.loco.apps option (a sandboxed unit per app, SQLite, nightly backups, nginx on a domain or a path), apps.nix and the notes demo in apps/notes, and docs/LOCO.md: adding an app, secrets on the box, growing SQLite.

pages.title: PGX
pages.purpose: pgx.nix and pgx/: the release packaged with autoPatchelfHook, the pgx unit and its sandbox, pg_hba.conf for loopback only, the pgx CLI wrapper, the VM test, and docs/PGX.md's cost and limits.

pages.title: Hermes Agent
pages.purpose: hermes.nix and docs/HERMES.md: the upstream NixOS module from the flake input hermes-agent, native mode, the minimal package with the anthropic and messaging extras, Claude through CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, the env file on the box and how activation copies it, MemoryMax and CPUWeight, the hermes CLI, checking, updating and turning it off.

pages.title: Kubernetes, tried and removed
pages.purpose: KubeSolo's run here (2026-10-30 to 2026-11-02) and its removal: kubesolo-purge.nix, the oneshot that clears what it left on the box, and docs/KUBERNETES.md and docs/MICROK8S.md, the surveys of small Kubernetes distributions for this VPS. Research and history, not configuration.

pages.title: The deploy doctor
pages.purpose: .github/workflows/deploy-doctor.yml: when deploy fails, piabrota/agents' deploy-doctor runs on a GitHub runner from an image pinned by digest, as the GitHub App piabrota-ops, and reports the failure; its secrets (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, OPS_BOT_APP_ID, OPS_BOT_KEY).

pages.title: Working on this repository
pages.purpose: AGENTS.md's rules for people and agents: branches, bipr pull requests (pt-BR then English), no agent trail and its one exception, never deploying by hand, never committing secrets, the justfiles that must run on Ubuntu 24.04's just, the bilingual docs and the wiki workflow.

pages.title: Forking for your own VPS
pages.purpose: docs/FORK.md: what to change in a fork, the manual steps on Hostinger and GitHub, and the first deploy.

pages.title: Claude and MCP setup
pages.purpose: .claude/skills (the vendored skills and their licences), .mcp.json (mcp-nixos, OpenPencil, DeepWiki) and docs/CLAUDE_PROJECT.md.
